Subject: Project Nimbus — Warm handoff and kickoff prep

Hi team,

Quick handoff note for Nimbus Health (NDL-4892) — contract executed last night, annual commit on Dedicated capacity plus a Managed SLO add-on. Main commercial points: 12-month term, 99.9% platform SLA for dedicated instances, waiver for sampling-based logging, and a two-week acceptance window tied to the SOW below.

Why this matters: Nimbus has strict latency and data locality requirements for their telehealth assistant; they want predictable per-token costs at scale. Key technical asks we flagged during demo: SSO (Okta), HIPAA BAAs, and a streaming-first endpoint for low-latency responses.

Attachments: Nimbus_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW reflecting SLA and acceptance criteria), MLP_checklist.xlsx (pre-kickoff items we discussed).

Asks for CS/Implementation:
- Confirm primary CS owner and Implementation PM (I recommend Tessa for CS lead, Vivek for PM).
- Schedule a 60-minute kickoff with customer (go-live target: 2026-12-20 as requested by Nimbus).
- Pre-kickoff tasks: customer to provide sandbox access and sample production prompts/data; Redwood team to prepare environment and run smoke tests.

I'll leave the scheduling and detailed runbook to you all. I can forward the DocuSign envelope if needed.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
